+from pathlib import Path

+

+
+
+def qnorm(q):
+    q = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
+    return q / np.linalg.norm(q)
+
+
+def qmul(a, b):
+    aw, ax, ay, az = a
+    bw, bx, by, bz = b
+    return np.array([aw*bw-ax*bx-ay*by-az*bz,
+                     aw*bx+ax*bw+ay*bz-az*by,
+                     aw*by-ax*bz+ay*bw+az*bx,
+                     aw*bz+ax*by-ay*bx+az*bw])
+
+
+def qinv(q):
+    q = qnorm(q)
+    return q * np.array([1., -1., -1., -1.])
+
+
+def qrot(q, v):
+    return qmul(qmul(qnorm(q), np.r_[0., v]), qinv(q))[1:]
+
+
+def qaxis(axis, angle):
+    axis = np.asarray(axis, float)
+    axis /= np.linalg.norm(axis)
+    return np.r_[math.cos(angle/2), axis*math.sin(angle/2)]
+
+
+def qbetween(a, b):
+    a = np.asarray(a, float); a /= np.linalg.norm(a)
+    b = np.asarray(b, float); b /= np.linalg.norm(b)
+    return qnorm(np.r_[1. + np.dot(a, b), np.cross(a, b)])
+
+
+def mug_axis(q):
+    return qrot(q, [0, 0, 1])
+
+
+def main():

+    print('initial mug', np.round(pos, 4), 'axis', np.round(axis, 4), 'ee', s.ee_pose())
+
+    s.record_start()
+    # Pinch the cylindrical body from above.  The mug's local +Z points from
+    # its base toward its mouth; its body is about 7 cm out from the base.
+    grasp_xy = pos + axis * 0.070
+    quat = p['top_down_quat'](0.0)  # jaws close along world Y, across the body
+    pre = np.array([grasp_xy[0], grasp_xy[1], 0.285])
+    contact = np.array([grasp_xy[0], grasp_xy[1], table_z + 0.046])

+
+    # Lift the body while maintaining the pinch.  If the pinch holds, rotate

+    ee_pos, ee_q = s.ee_pose()
+    p['move_ee'](ee_pos + np.array([0., 0., 0.105]), ee_q, speed=0.08,
